Warnings array is empty even for malformed HTML (parser is lenient)

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    html = "<p>Unclosed paragraph<div>Mixed nesting</p></div>"
    result = convert(html)
    print(result.content)
    print(result.warnings)

main()
```
